title: Reshaping CAR-T cells through overexpression of T cell factor 1.
authors: Yao, Hao; Ding, Yuntian; Chen, Qian; Han, Huixiu; Sedloev, David; Muller-Tidow, Carsten; Sauer, Tim; Schmitt, Anita; Schmitt, Michael; Wang, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究过表达转录因子TCF-1增强CAR-T细胞持久性，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属免疫细胞工程应用，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Although chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy has revolutionized treatment for hematologic malignancies, insufficient CAR-T cell persistence remains a major limitation. T cell factor 1 (TCF-1) is a transcription factor crucial for T cell development, self-renewal, and memory formation. However, CAR-T cells typically exhibit low TCF-1 expression. This study investigated whether restoring TCF-1 expression could enhance CAR-T cell persistence and functionality. METHODS: Human peripheral blood T cells were transduced with third-generation CD19 or CD33 CAR retroviral vectors, with or without a TCF-1 (Tcf7.NGFR) construct. Phenotypic, functional, and transcriptional analyses were performed using flow cytometry, cytokine profiling, long-term killing assays, and RNA sequencing. Data mining and machine learning were applied for high-dimensional immunophenotyping. RESULTS: TCF-1 overexpression generated CAR-T cells with reduced apoptosis, lower activation marker expression, and an increased proportion of naive and stem cell-like subsets. These modified cells displayed a higher CD4(+)/CD8(+) ratio, preserved proliferative capacity, and maintained cytotoxicity with attenuated cytokine release. Long-term co-culture assays demonstrated superior persistence and sustained tumor-killing activity in TCF-1-overexpressing CAR-T cells. Transcriptomic profiling revealed downregulation of apoptotic and cytokine release pathways, and enrichment of cell cycle and metabolic pathways supporting T cell longevity. DISCUSSION: Overexpression of TCF-1 confers resistance to apoptosis, limits excessive activation, and promotes a less differentiated phenotype, collectively enhancing CAR-T cell persistence and long-term efficacy. These findings suggest that TCF-1 modulation represents a promising strategy to improve durability and safety of CAR-T cell therapy in relapsed or refractory hematologic malignancies.
abstract_zh: 引言：尽管嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞疗法已革新了血液系统恶性肿瘤的治疗，但CAR-T细胞持久性不足仍是一个主要限制。T细胞因子1（TCF-1）是对T细胞发育、自我更新和记忆形成至关重要的转录因子。然而，CAR-T细胞通常表现出低水平的TCF-1表达。本研究探讨了恢复TCF-1表达是否能增强CAR-T细胞的持久性和功能性。方法：将人外周血T细胞转导第三代CD19或CD33 CAR逆转录病毒载体，含或不含TCF-1（Tcf7.NGFR）构建体。通过流式细胞术、细胞因子谱分析、长期杀伤实验和RNA测序进行表型、功能和转录组分析。应用数据挖掘和机器学习进行高维免疫表型分析。结果：TCF-1过表达产生的CAR-T细胞表现出凋亡减少、活化标志物表达降低，以及初始和干细胞样亚群比例增加。这些修饰细胞显示出更高的CD4(+)/CD8(+)比率，保留了增殖能力，并在细胞因子释放减弱的情况下维持了细胞毒性。长期共培养实验表明，TCF-1过表达的CAR-T细胞具有优越的持久性和持续的肿瘤杀伤活性。转录组分析揭示了凋亡和细胞因子释放通路的下调，以及支持T细胞长寿的细胞周期和代谢通路的富集。讨论：TCF-1的过表达赋予抗凋亡能力，限制过度活化，并促进较少分化的表型，共同增强CAR-T细胞的持久性和长期疗效。这些发现表明，TCF-1调节代表了改善复发或难治性血液系统恶性肿瘤中CAR-T细胞疗法持久性和安全性的有前景策略。
